lead_headline: Nothing new detected today after weekend's 8-lead haul — but Pizzeria Lui's 10-year run and Church & Union's 2-year stint both ended

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today — tracker idle after Friday-Sunday logged 8 changes including Ciao Babe (Avanti), Mother Other (Baker), and closures of Pizzeria Lui, Church & Union.

liquor.blurb: Monday silence continues: zero applications detected for second consecutive trading day as metro licensing activity tracks seasonal lull. Weekly count 152 — half the prior week's 274, confirming January's license-freeze backlog fully cleared. No status changes today after weekend saw Honey Elixir Lounge (Walnut) upgrade from delinquent, HuHot Mongolian Grill (Northfield) downgrade to delinquent. Baseline pace restored.

reputation.blurb: 5 mentions today led by Denver Post investor profile, Instagram SOL Mexican Cocina closure post, Facebook brewery relocation coverage. Notable pickups: neglected property analysis, construction roundup, artist commission inquiry. Daily average 10.1 vs. prior week's 10.9 — slide moderates but persists.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) — first positive day since July 16 stabilizes MTD at −28 (−1.4/day). 90-day net holds at +81. Past 14 days: 26 new vs. 68 canceled for −42 net — 2.6:1 churn ratio intensifies from prior fortnight's 1.9:1. July's 21 days yield 30 acquisitions against 58 cancellations, delivering monthly pace of −1.3/day vs. YTD's +1.0/day. Single positive day insufficient to reverse trend — pattern suggests Q2 gains eroding into Q3.
